kind: Current-source ordinary release AppModel retained-canvas and count-driven full-source eviction collection; descriptive single run

provenance.sourceState: Existing dirty working tree frozen in matching source archive; no clean-commit equivalence claimed

environment.hardware: Apple M4 Pro, Mac16,7, 48 GiB RAM
environment.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.1.2 (swiftlang-6.1.2.1.2 clang-1700.0.13.5)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx15.0

environmentManifest.role: Earlier same-machine/toolchain environment capture; compiled cohort uses retention-and-detection manifest

workload.settingsIsolation: Temporary PerFileSettingsStore/ProfileStore and isolated UserDefaults suite
workload.retainedCanvasStorageContract: Each complete corrected bitmap is reduced to half its width and height while retaining full logical dimensions; sizes are source-contract evidence, not stored per-switch bitmap dimensions
workload.sourceCountEvictionEvidence: Three sources and cache count two; every measured target lacks a cachedSourceKindBeforeSelection, two rawFull sessions remain after settlement, and every measured selection accepts one full-source decode

measurement.finalCorrectedHashPhase: DSCF2833 hash is after the post-navigation exposure edit to 0.25 and Original departure/recovery; other frames retain their initial settings. Navigation equality used the separate pre-edit warmup hashes in the harness, which are not emitted.

correctnessGuards: All 24 settled navigation bitmaps matched their per-frame pre-edit warmup hashes; actual current photo adjustments, density profile, film base, publication parameters, rawFull source kind, and full logical dimensions were checked.
All immediate retained publications matched current parameters and full logical source dimensions; their half-size storage is not full-resolution detail.
The post-navigation first-frame exposure edit replaced retained pixels with current publication and changed the corrected bitmap hash.
Original produced different pixels, departed with Original disabled, and later returned to the same edited corrected hash and exposure.
Simulated app pressure removed unselected sessions and all retained canvases, preserving the current bitmap hash and logical dimensions; recovery hashes and settings matched.

Close All drained background work, cleared displayed pixels, all sessions and retained canvases, and charged preview bytes; weak AppModel release was verified before the final physical-footprint sample.
All three original RAW file SHA256 values were identical before and after the run.
limits: Programmatic AppModel publication, not native-input or screen-presentation latency.
Immediate retained-canvas publication and settled full-source output are timed separately; no full-detail first-display claim is made.
The first three frames prime the app cache; filesystem caches are uncontrolled.
The two-session count limit drives this cohort's eviction; the normal machine byte budget is not deliberately saturated.
Charged preview bytes are accounting, distinct from process physical footprint.
Peak footprint covers the process lifetime and is not a per-switch peak.
Pressure is simulated by the app handler, not induced system-wide memory pressure.
Full-source decode counts exclude discarded results and native work cancelled before publication.
Three X-T5 scans and descriptive samples do not establish general performance or memory gains.
Bitmap hashes and source hashes check reuse correctness, not photographic quality.
Source/toolchain binary-manifest evidence should accompany this report for comparisons.
One current-source run has no matched old-code control and does not establish an improvement or regression.

The machine was not verified quiescent: a read-only check at 2026-10-11 07:11 UTC found unrelated CPU workloads. They were left alone; this process ran serially relative to study builds and benchmarks.
Sub-millisecond retained-publication values cover synchronous programmatic model state immediately after loadSelection, not an awaited display frame or screen presentation.
All 24 navigation samples accepted one full-source decode and one correction each, with zero rendered raster cache hits; retained canvas reuse does not mean decoded-source reuse.
Reported decoder counters count accepted results; cancelled or discarded native decode work is excluded.
Pressure calls the app handler directly; no OS notification delivery, system-wide pressure, or thermal-cost validation was performed.

Verified model release left 317313080 bytes of process physical footprint versus 7406096 bytes before model creation. It establishes model/cache ownership release, not complete physical return or a cause for the residual.
The process-lifetime peak is cumulative; settled phase samples do not establish each operation peak.
Navigation bitmap hashes are same-workload reuse guards; no fresh CPU oracle, CPU/Metal parity, or photographic quality claim is made.
